newsitem.title: UK: Sterling rises above 2.91 to set new 5-year high.
newsitem.headline: Sterling rises above 2.91 to set new 5-year high.

text.p: Sterling leapt above 2.91 marks for the first time in five years, rebounding from earlier lows, amid expectations the fiscal tightening announced in the UK budget was not enough to head off higher interest rates.
Sterling bounced as much as two-and-a-half pfennigs from earlier low to trade as high as 2.9120 marks. It was last at 2.9100/07 from 2.9025/35 at 1430GMT and an initial low of 2.8870.
